Workflow_Roles.responsibility: First approver. Resolved from the requester's department in Department_Heads.
Reviews quotes and vendor quality, approves mid-value purchases.
Checks budget, approves high-value purchases, signs off payment exceptions.
Reviews purchases that involve personal or sensitive data.
Reviews long contracts and conflicts of interest.
Releases payment only after the audit check passes.

Approval_Matrix.notes: Small purchase: the department head alone approves.
Very large purchase: same chain, plus board notification outside this system. No upper limit.

Extra_Approvals.condition: Request involves personal or sensitive data
Vendor was onboarded less than 90 days ago
Only one vendor quoted and the amount is above 2,00,000
Purchase would exceed the department's remaining budget
Vendor bank details changed in the last 30 days
